summary: Raised-limit boundary tests added for title length (121, 200, 201) on create/update and the router; two existing 121-char rejection cases updated to 201 as the description intends. Stored 120-char limits elsewhere are reported.

decisions.reason: Title max 120 -> 200: added accept 121/200, trim, reject 201 on update, router 201 for 200 chars; moved rejection case to 201.

impact.risk: Title column is VarChar(120); a 121-200 character title now passes validation but the database rejects it, so saving fails with 500.
Raw DDL creates title VARCHAR(120); existing and new tables keep the old limit, so long titles fail on insert.
Frontend still blocks titles over 120 characters with a 120-character message, so users cannot enter 121-200.
OpenAPI still documents title maxLength 120, so generated clients reject valid titles.
The 422 error message still says titles up to 120 characters.
